name: G protein subunit beta 1

function.text: GNB1 encodes guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(I)/G(S)/G(T) subunit beta-1. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and signaling receptor complex adaptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 42 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
